name: flood
title: River flood exercise - Riverside district
description: Fictional exercise: a river flood has displaced residents of the Riverside district. A community hall operates as a temporary shelter. All names, places and needs are invented.

requests.title: Drinking water for community hall shelter
requests.description: About 60 people at the community hall shelter need drinking water for the next 24 hours.

requests.title: Blankets for overnight stay
requests.description: Sports hall will host families overnight. Blankets needed.

requests.title: Phone charging station at shelter
requests.description: Residents need to charge phones to stay in contact with family.

requests.title: Transport from Mill Street to shelter
requests.description: Two residents with reduced mobility need non-emergency transport to the shelter.
requests.contact: Ask for the household at the door (exercise contact)

requests.title: Diapers size 4 and baby food
requests.description: Family with infant at sports hall.

requests.title: Interpreter for information session
requests.description: Information session at 18:00 needs Arabic and Ukrainian interpretation.

requests.title: Warm meals for volunteers
requests.description: Lunch for volunteer team at sandbag station.

offers.title: Bottled water from depot
offers.description: Pallets of 1.5 l bottles at the municipal depot.

offers.title: Power banks and charging cables
offers.description: 20 charged power banks with USB-C and Lightning cables.

offers.title: Accessible van with driver
offers.description: Wheelchair-accessible van, available in the afternoon.
